import csv,json
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/work/workspace');out=root/'deliverable/month_10';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def rows(p):
 with (root/p).open(newline='') as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))
def c(v):return int((Decimal(str(v))*100).quantize(Decimal('1')))
def m(v):return float(Decimal(v)/100)
inv=rows('documents/month_10/invoices.csv');rec=rows('documents/month_10/cash_receipts.csv');bills=rows('documents/month_10/vendor_bills.csv');pay=json.loads((root/'documents/month_10/payroll_register.json').read_text());prior=json.loads((root/'deliverable/month_09/trial_balance.json').read_text())['accounts']
entries=[]
def add(ref,date,memo,lines):
 ls=[{'account':str(a),'debit':m(d),'credit':m(cr)} for a,d,cr in lines]
 assert sum(c(x['debit'])-c(x['credit']) for x in ls)==0,ref
 entries.append({'ref':ref,'date':date,'memo':memo,'lines':ls})
for x in inv:
 amt=c(x['amount']);add('BILL-'+x['invoice'],x['date'],x['invoice']+' '+x['customer']+'; '+x['description']+('; issued in error after cancellation; reversed by CM-INV-2434' if x['invoice']=='INV-2434' else ''),[('1100',amt,0),('4000',0,amt)])
add('CM-INV-2434','2025-10-06','Credit erroneous October invoice INV-2434 for Alder Studios LLC C-012, cancelled effective August 31; no October service or revenue',[('4000',180000,0),('1100',0,180000)])
for x in rec:
 amt=c(x['amount']);add('RCPT-'+x['applied_to'],x['date'],'Receipt from '+x['customer']+' applied to '+x['applied_to'],[('1000',amt,0),('1100',0,amt)])
cat={'Hosting & infrastructure':'5100','Rent':'5200','G&A other':'5300','Software & tools':'5400','Marketing':'5500'}
for n,x in enumerate(bills,1):
 amt=c(x['amount']);add(f'VB-{n:02}',x['date'],x['vendor']+' bill; '+x['category_hint'],[(cat[x['category_hint']],amt,0),('2000',0,amt)])
 add(f'PAY-VB-{n:02}',x['date'],'Bank payment to '+x['vendor'],[('2000',amt,0),('1000',0,amt)])
gross=c(pay['gross']);er=c(pay['employer_taxes_benefits']);net=c(pay['net_pay']);remit=c(pay['taxes_remitted']);withheld=gross-net
assert withheld+er==remit
add('PR-2025-10-25',pay['date'],'October payroll gross wages and employee withholding',[('5000',gross,0),('1000',0,net),('2100',0,withheld)])
add('PR-ER-2025-10-25',pay['date'],'October employer taxes and benefits accrued',[('5010',er,0),('2100',0,er)])
add('PR-TAX-2025-10-25',pay['date'],'October payroll tax remittance: employee withholding plus employer taxes and benefits',[('2100',remit,0),('1000',0,remit)])
for ref,memo,amt in [
('REV-TRESTLE-NEW-2025-10','Trestle Jan–Dec 2025 annual contract: October ratable release',200000),
('REV-PINECONE-2025-10','Pinecone Feb 2025–Jan 2026 annual subscription: October ratable release',300000),
('REV-MARIGOLD-2025-10','Marigold Mar 2025–Feb 2026 annual contract: October ratable release',150000),
('REV-QUARRY-2025-10','Quarry May 2025–Apr 2026 annual contract: October ratable release',250000),
('REV-SALTLINE-2025-10','Saltline Jun 2025–May 2026 annual contract: October ratable release',180000),
('REV-VIREO-2025-10','Vireo Sep 2025–Aug 2026 annual contract: October ratable release',225000)]:
 add(ref,'2025-10-31',memo,[('2200',amt,0),('4000',0,amt)])
add('DEP-2025-10','2025-10-31','Monthly computer equipment depreciation per close checklist',[('5900',177778,0),('1510',0,177778)])
entries.sort(key=lambda x:(x['date'],x['ref']))
(out/'journal_entries.json').write_text(json.dumps(entries,indent=2)+'\\n')
tb=defaultdict(lambda:[0,0])
for acct,x in prior.items():tb[acct][0]+=c(x['debit']);tb[acct][1]+=c(x['credit'])
for e in entries:
 for l in e['lines']:tb[l['account']][0]+=c(l['debit']);tb[l['account']][1]+=c(l['credit'])
accounts={}
for acct,(dr,cr) in sorted(tb.items()):
 net=dr-cr;accounts[acct]={'debit':m(max(net,0)),'credit':m(max(-net,0))}
assert sum(c(x['debit'])-c(x['credit']) for x in accounts.values())==0
(out/'trial_balance.json').write_text(json.dumps({'accounts':accounts},indent=2)+'\\n')
roll={'contracts':{
'Trestle Freight LLC — Jan–Dec 2025':{'opening':6000,'billed':0,'recognized':2000,'closing':4000},
'Pinecone Dental Group — Feb 2025–Jan 2026':{'opening':12000,'billed':0,'recognized':3000,'closing':9000},
'Marigold Schools Inc — Mar 2025–Feb 2026':{'opening':7500,'billed':0,'recognized':1500,'closing':6000},
'Quarry Analytics Co — May 2025–Apr 2026':{'opening':17500,'billed':0,'recognized':2500,'closing':15000},
'Saltline Hospitality — Jun 2025–May 2026':{'opening':14400,'billed':0,'recognized':1800,'closing':12600},
'Vireo Clinics PBC — Sep 2025–Aug 2026':{'opening':24750,'billed':0,'recognized':2250,'closing':22500}},
'unallocated_opening_deferred_revenue':{'opening':24000,'billed':0,'recognized':0,'closing':24000},
'total':{'opening':106150,'billed':0,'recognized':13050,'closing':93100}}
(out/'deferred_revenue_rollforward.json').write_text(json.dumps(roll,indent=2)+'\\n')
print('entries',len(entries),'invoice total',sum(c(x['amount']) for x in inv)/100,'receipts',sum(c(x['amount']) for x in rec)/100,'bills',sum(c(x['amount']) for x in bills)/100,'TB sides',sum(c(x['debit']) for x in accounts.values())/100,sum(c(x['credit']) for x in accounts.values())/100)
print(json.dumps(accounts,indent=2))
